text: TeeVee Toons makes the choice of legal regime concrete: the same dispute about a written agreement receives a different evidentiary analysis under the CISG than under the restrictive domestic approach in Gianni.
sourceSummary: Under the CISG, a factual dispute about the parties’ intent to exclude printed terms—including their merger clause—prevented summary judgment based on those terms.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
